entities.name: Q12358
observations: Reviewed Saccharomyces cerevisiae alpha-ketoglutarate-dependent sulfonate dioxygenase.
Binds one Fe(II) ion per subunit and is annotated with EC 1.14.11.-.
Participates in organosulfur and alkanesulfonate degradation; localized to the cytoplasm.
Reference binding-site annotations occur at positions 218, 220, 245, 367, and 379/383.
